02.
1. Heard Mr. P.S. Nayak, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. D.K. Mishra, learned Addl.
Government Advocate for the State.
2.

This is an application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the petitioner in connection with Plantsite P.S. Case No. 245 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.1213 of 2023 pending in the Court of the learned S.D.J.M.(P), Rourkela under Sections 498-A, 376(2)(n), 292(2), 324, 34 of IPC read with Sections 66-A, 67-A of I.T. Act.
3.

The prayer for bail of the petitioner has been rejected vide order dated 24.08.2023 by 2nd Additional Sessions Judge, Rourkela on the ground that there is chance of tampering of the prosecution evidence and considering the nature and gravity of the offence and manner of commission of the offences.

4. The prosecution allegation in brief is that the husband of the informant had taken loan from one Afroz Akhtar @ Papu but could not repay the debt and forced the informant to keep physical relation with said Afroz Akhtar @ Papu used to come to the house of the informant and force himself on the informant.
This continued for 7 to 8 months and then the informant changed house and moved to Panposh.
However, the said Papu and the husband of the informant still used to harass the informant.
So, the informant left that place and stayed with her father at Bisra Check gate.
On 20.07.2023, the husband and brother-in-law of the informant (petitioner) forcibly took the informant and her children in a car.
Papu tried to force himself on the informant in the car and the husband of the informant assaulted the informant on his head.
The informant was able to escape with her children.

1 circulate the same with the others and blackmail the informant.
The accused persons threatened the informant, they would do away with the children of the informant and make her videos viral.
5. Mr. P.S. Nayak, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody since 22.07.2023.

He further submits that the main allegations in the case are against co-accused Md.
Afroz Akhtar @ Pappu and Mojammil Hussain, husband of the victim who is the brother of the petitioner.

Although the FIR has been registered under Sections 498-A, 376(2)(n), 292(2), 324, 34 of IPC read with Sections 66-A, 67-A of I.T. Act, charge sheet has been filed in this case where the petitioner is accused of committing the offence under Sections 498-A, 354, 109 of IPC read with Section 67-A of I.T. Act even though there is no allegation against him for commission of offence under Section 67-A of I.T. Act.
He further submits that the chargesheet has been filed against the other co- accused persons under Sections 376(2)(n), 292(2), 324, 506 of IPC read with Sections 66-A, 67-A of I.T. Act.
6. Mr. D.K. Mishra, learned Addl. Government Advocate for the State opposes the prayer for bail stating that the petitioner is the brother- in-law of the victim and has done nothing to protect her.
On the other hand he had gone with the main accused to bring her from the father's house and she has been assaulted on the way by the co-accused.
7. The prayer for bail of the two co-accused has been rejected by this Court.

BLAPL No.10530 of 2023 filed by Mojammil Hussain has been dismissed on 04.10.2023 and BLAPL No.10587 of 2023 filed by the co- accused, Md. Afroz Akhtar @ Pappu has been dismissed on 04.10.2023.
8.

Considering the nature of allegations against the petitioner who is the brother in law of the victim,
the period of his detention in custody, I am inclined to allow the prayer for bail.

9. Let the petitioner- Danish Hussain be released on bail on such terms and conditions as may be fixed by the learned Court below in seisin over the matter, including the following conditions:
(i) He will not commit any offence while on bail.
( ii) He will report before the Plantsite Police Station once in a week on every Sunday between 3.00 p.m. to 5.00 p.m. till conclusion of trial.
(iii) He will not threaten or try to influence prosecution witnesses or tamper with evidence.
10. Violation of any condition will entail in cancellation of bail.
11. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
12. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
